journey.name: Favorites Journey
journey.description: User can click on items in favorites and the app map navigates to those specific region of interest in the map.

actions.action: Go to Favorites Tab, verify that there is Gibraltar and the Philippines in the list.
Press on Gibraltar and check if display transitioned to the Map tab.
Verify if Map is focused on Gibraltar.
Go to Favorites Tab and press on Philippines in the list.
Verify if Map is focused on the Philippines.
